title: Perfection of proper direct image of a relatively flat single module
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be proper, locally of finite presentation and quasi-compact [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], and $F$ a finitely presented module flat over $f$. Supply independent derived localizations on $X$ and $S$ and the localized open sites of $S$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Then $Rf_*(F[0])$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image] is perfect on $S$ [def-pc-perfect-complex]. No chosen Cech complex or base-change comparison occurs in this assertion.

source.place: Tag 0B91(2), specialized proof of Tag 0A1H with E=O_X and G=F[0]

proof.text: At a point x choose an affine neighbourhood U. Transport the supplied localization on the open site S/U along Modules.overEquiv U to obtain the scheme localization on U in the same morphism universe. For each open V of U, put A equal to its open image in S; compose Modules.overEquiv V, module restriction along the inverse of the scheme isomorphism V -> A, and (Modules.overEquiv A).symm. This exact equivalence transports the supplied localization at A to the open site U/V. Degreewise equivalence preserves quasi-isomorphisms, so Mathlib IsLocalization.of_equivalence_source supplies the localization. No family of localizations on all schemes is assumed.

Apply the open pseudo-coherence theorem to the exact open restriction of Rf_*(F[0]). Apply the affine-open finite-Tor theorem to the same object. The pseudo-coherent finite-Tor criterion yields perfection on U in exactly the transported localizations.

Apply the open-restriction perfect-local-model theorem at x in U. It transports a strictly perfect local model on U to an ambient open of S and returns exactly the witness required by S.IsPerfect. Doing this for every x proves the statement; on an empty S there are no points.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A1H Noetherian approximation and finite-flat-Cech argument separated into pseudo-coherence and finite Tor dimension, combined by 08CQ and exact-open locality; C1
